json_result.metric: max absolute error over all finite FP16 values vs FP64 atan

evidence.summary: Exhaustive sweep of all 63488 finite FP16 values (bit patterns 0..65535, chunked through kernel.run on GPU) compared against FP64 torch.atan: 5606 values exceed the 1e-6 absolute tolerance. Max error 5.03e-6 at x=0.6220703125 (actual 0.5564948, ref 0.5564898). Errors exceed tolerance in all three range regions (|x|<0.66: 5.03e-6, 0.66<|x|<=2.414: 3.31e-6, |x|>2.414: 3.26e-6), consistent with the truncated single-precision Cephes coefficients.

rationale: The single-precision Cephes-style coefficients with truncated constants may produce errors above the contract's fixed 1e-6 absolute tolerance for some finite FP16 inputs, particularly near the interval boundaries (|x|≈0.66, |x|≈2.414) and at the extrema ±65504.

scope_evidence.summary: Contract requires 'abs(actual[i] - atan(x[i])) <= 1e-6' for 'EVERY finite FP16 value', including 'both extrema +/-65504' and subnormals.

scope_rationale: The contract requires every output element to satisfy abs(actual[i] - atan(x[i])) <= 1e-6 over EVERY finite FP16 value, so any input in that domain with error > 1e-6 violates the contract.
statement: The kernel's output exceeds the 1e-6 absolute error tolerance for at least one finite FP16 input value.
